resolution: Phase 2: calibrated band covers about 80 percent at every lead time up to 20 days (54 percent within 6 days before); method in README and COMPARISON.md.

title: Short histories hide bills and lose to a naive baseline

recommendation: Treat single large debits as provisional monthly bills or ask the user, fall back to mean outflow under 60 days, no Enough under 28 days
resolution: Phase 2: no Enough under 28 days, under 14 days Not enough to tell, and usual spend never below the plain outflow average under 45 days.

recommendation: Add the assumption, bills, income and range to aria-valuetext; rename or relabel the per-day state

title: Keyboard focus hidden behind fixed bottom tab bar (2.4.11)

recommendation: Add tabIndex 0, role region and label; simplify the table on phones

title: Multilingual, low-literacy audience gets English only

recommendation: Ship 2 or 3 reviewed languages first; add read-aloud on the date; rewrite privacy copy to grade 5

title: Import errors not explained or announced (3.3.1, 3.3.3, 4.1.3)
evidence: en.json:582 readError; Feedback.tsx:54 Notice not live; Import.tsx:248 aria-invalid without message
recommendation: Add next step to errors, role alert, visible balance error, keep button enabled

title: Negative amounts may be read without minus (Assumption)
evidence: results/manual.json chart.ayanda.slider "-R384"; src/lib/format.ts:13
recommendation: Use "minus R384" or "R384 below zero" in spoken text; verify on NVDA and TalkBack

title: Truncated descriptions and roles lose meaning
evidence: ayanda-home-light-390.png "Cash deposit, shop takin…"; results/home-320.png "Spaza s…"
recommendation: Use two-line clamp instead of truncate

title: Command menu keyboard-only with unannounced groups
evidence: results/manual.json commandMenu.mobileOpenButtonVisible 0; CommandPalette.tsx:197; results/command-menu.json opensFromTextField 1
recommendation: Use role group with labels; ignore shortcut in non-empty text fields

title: Low-end Android parses 337 KB of untranslated locale JSON
evidence: docs/review/prep/audit.md; perf-home.json cold hero 1516 ms at 4x CPU
recommendation: Lazy-load the active locale; test on a real entry-level Android Go phone

title: No plan yet for accessible login, consistent help or testing with disabled users
evidence: no auth in app; walkthrough.md is developer-only; 3.2.6 and 3.3.8 apply once real
recommendation: Design biometric or paste-friendly login, one Help link in the same place on every page, test with TalkBack and low-literacy users

title: Safe to spend can license overspending and hides the next big bill
evidence: Lerato R330 safe vs R120 usual; following it daily drops Enough to Tight, date 1 Nov to 25 Oct (docs/review/tools/behavioural/frames.ts); rent R2 800 on 1 Nov not shown (lerato-home-dark-1280.png); src/engine/forecast.ts perDay
recommendation: Cap at the amount that keeps the current state, rename "Spend up to R… a day to stay Enough", always show the next large bill after next money
resolution: Phase 1: usual spend shown beside the budget and the next large bill just after next money is kept back and named.

title: Model sees one bank account while users live in cash, wallets and several accounts
evidence: No cash ledger, manual entry or transfer rule in src/engine or src/lib; FinScope 2023 94 percent withdraw cash monthly; SARB cash 56 percent of payments by volume; seed deposits cash fares daily (src/data/seed/generate.ts)
recommendation: Add cash in hand, quick entries, transfer detection and a prompt on large deposits; label the date "bank account only" until cash is added

title: Safe to lend anchors a default and double counts the same buffer
evidence: "Use R320" chip (src/pages/Plan.tsx:204-238); canSetAside reuses safeToLend (src/engine/help.ts:49); lend R280 plus spend R330 drops Lerato to Tight (frames.ts); no repayment option
recommendation: Reframe as give or lend without dropping a level, show one shared budget, remove or relabel the chip, add expected repayment date, show days lost instead of "no amount is safe"
resolution: Phase 1: Room to lend keeps the reserve and leaves a budget above zero; Help says it is the same room, not extra. No repayment date yet.

title: Conflicting signals undermine comprehension and trust
evidence: "Enough until" with Tight chip (src/components/forecast/DateHero.tsx:9); hero Short vs chart Enough (ayanda-home-light-390.png); two daily targets R310 and about R373 for Ayanda; headline at band edge for Lerato (persona-snapshot.json)
recommendation: State-neutral label, one daily number per state, explicit hero and chart reconciliation line, test range comprehension
resolution: Phase 1: one daily number per state, chart labelled as the if-usual case, What helps uses the same typical next-money date.

title: Business inputs treated as household spending to cut
evidence: Ayanda top spend stock R15 137 and advice to spend R250 less a day (persona-snapshot.json); Thabo told to move car instalment (walkthrough.md item 10)
recommendation: Add a business stock and fuel group excluded from cuts, timing-based advice, exclude vehicle finance and funeral cover from bill moves
resolution: Phase 3: stock and transport are work costs, never offered for cuts; vehicle finance and funeral cover never moved.

title: Daily bad news risks avoidance, anxiety and exposure on shared phones
evidence: Daily 07:00 Short message (ayanda-inbox-light-390.png, en.json:666-682); ostrich effect (Karlsson et al. 2009); nudge side effects (Medina 2021)
recommendation: Change-based messages, neutral lock-screen preview, action-first copy naming a specific cost, track opt-out by state

title: Stokvels, burial societies, family transfers and informal credit absent
evidence: No such entries in src/data/seed/generate.ts; FinScope 2023 informal savings 30 percent, burial society 29 percent; stokvel payout can pass the 10 percent next money threshold (src/engine/forecast.ts:24)
recommendation: Add these flows to a persona, let users tag deposits as one-off or stokvel payout and contributions as commitments

title: Date-first behavioural claim is unproven
evidence: No published runway vs balance experiment found; README.md:5 implies it; nearest evidence is adjacent (Hershfield et al., Karlan et al.)
recommendation: Present as a hypothesis and test it in task T2 of the user study

title: Account-level view can be gamed or used strategically
evidence: State depends only on the imported account balance (src/engine/forecast.ts forecast); Assumption on frequency
recommendation: Treat as a design input, ask about showing or hiding the screen in testing, keep shared messages free of amounts

title: Ten of 11 languages are English
evidence: All 10 locale files byte-identical to en.json; status.json all pending; translated-from.json empty
recommendation: Claim "built for 11, N live"; get speakers to write the money keys for 2 to 3 Gauteng languages and mark them reviewed
resolution: Phase 3: honest claim and status chips; translations need first-language speakers (docs/HUMAN-ACTIONS.md).

title: Tshivenda not in Cloud Translation; a full run would leave files inconsistent
evidence: Cloud Translation language page lists no Venda; translate.mjs:16,76,123,127-128; i18n-sync.mjs:33; README estimate 155k vs about 171.6k chars
recommendation: Human-translate ve; save status after each language; pre-check supported targets; fix README figure
resolution: Phase 3: translate.mjs never sends Tshivenda, marks it needsTranslator, saves status after every language; i18n-check fails if ve is ever machine.

title: MT money messages without glossary, context or in-message caveat
evidence: translate.mjs:74 bare strings, v2 no glossary; 156 strings of 12 chars or fewer incl. state words; notice only at LanguageSelector.tsx:53-57; Google and Stellenbosch quality caveats
recommendation: Block MT on money keys until reviewed; speaker term base; v3 glossary and context; bilingual notice in app shell
resolution: Phase 3: money strings are not machine translated unless --include-money; src/i18n/glossary.json holds money terms for translators. No in-message caveat because nothing is machine translated yet.

title: Review status is per language, not per string
evidence: translate.mjs:124 keeps reviewed after new MT strings; LanguageSelector.tsx:56 claims speaker-checked
recommendation: Track reviewed status per key; show reviewed only when all keys are reviewed
resolution: Phase 3: src/i18n/review-status.json tracks review per string; a language is reviewed only when every key is, enforced by i18n-check.

title: html lang declares a language the text is not in
evidence: Preferences.tsx:12 sets lang=ve on English content; Inbox.tsx:117; WCAG 3.1.1 and 3.1.2
recommendation: Use lang=en while pending; mark English fallback strings lang=en
resolution: Phase 3: same as A11Y-01, with data-ui-language keeping the chosen language.

title: Word order and agreement fixed in code
evidence: WhyDrawer.tsx:105, Import.tsx:260, privacy/Review.tsx:22 concatenate; {{state}} and English date interpolated; DateHero.tsx:9 shows Enough until for Tight
recommendation: One key per full sentence; month and day names in locales; nest nav labels; test bold on WhatsApp

title: SMS limit check only works for English and GSM
evidence: MessageWriter.ts:28 160; Inbox.tsx:129 counts length; templates.test.ts English only; ê ë ô š ḓ not GSM-7 so 70 per SMS
recommendation: Count segments by encoding; test every language; per-language short SMS
resolution: Phase 3: smsSegments() counts GSM-7 and UCS-2 parts; Inbox shows encoding and parts; tests cover both.

title: Layout clips expanded text
evidence: expansion.l10n.ts at 360px: bottom nav truncates Money and Inbox (AppLayout.tsx:171,185); StateChip nowrap squeezes Me rows; channel control stacks; shots/pseudo-ve-ibm-inbox-360.png
recommendation: Two-line nav labels; shrinkable chips; wrapping segmented control; keep pseudo-locale in CI

title: Quality gates do not check translations
evidence: i18n-check.mjs checks keys and exclamation marks only; fonts-check passes only because all text is English
recommendation: Check placeholder and bold parity, dashes, share identical to English; Tshivenda font fixture
resolution: Phase 3: i18n-check fails on placeholder or bold marker mismatch and on unknown statuses.

title: Plural rules need briefing and tests
evidence: Intl.PluralRules zu and nso map 0 to one, so i18next renders the _one form for 0; no non-English plural tests
recommendation: Brief translators; test plural keys for 0, 1, 2 in all languages

title: Decomposed Tshivenda characters use a fallback font
evidence: glyphs.mjs: Inter lacks U+032D and U+0307; no NFC normalisation in translate.mjs or CSV import
recommendation: Normalise to NFC everywhere; add rule to i18n-check
resolution: Phase 3: i18n-check fails on any string that is not NFC normalised.

title: Name origin unconfirmed, may mean price not value
evidence: README.md:106-110; en.json:460; only hit is a Shona page glossing mutengo as price (unverified)
recommendation: Confirm with two Tshivenda speakers before pitch; fix gloss everywhere
resolution: Phase 3: the name story is behind VITE_SHOW_NAME_STORY, off by default, with a TODO to confirm with two Tshivenda speakers.

title: Demo safety label English in every language
evidence: translate.mjs:18 keeps common.demoChip as "Demo, Fictional Data"
recommendation: Show translated label alongside English

title: All locales bundled eagerly
evidence: i18n/index.ts:5 eager glob; 337 KB of locale JSON in a 696 KB bundle
recommendation: Bundle English only; lazy-load and cache the chosen language

title: No defensible moat against the bank building it
evidence: src/engine/forecast.ts is simple percentile maths; FNB nav» Money available funds (BusinessTech 2018); Standard Bank Future Payments; FNB 8.16m digitally active (BusinessDay 2026-09-16)
recommendation: Lead with backtested accuracy, tested multilingual content and a pilot playbook; license the engine; do not claim a tech moat

title: Single-bank unit economics do not break even
evidence: model-inputs.md funnel gives about 44 000 MAU; R5 per MAU less R1.23 cost gives R166k contribution against R310k fixed; break-even about 82 000 MAU
recommendation: Pilot fee plus per-MAU fee plus annual platform floor; plan a second bank or white-label within 18 months

title: Daily paid messaging costs more than the licence fee
evidence: WhatsApp utility USD 0.0095 (ChatMaxima, Meta) x 30 x R16.13 = R4.60; marketing R18.34; SMS R0.24 x 30 = R7.20 (Panacea)
recommendation: Default to in-app push; WhatsApp on state change, at most weekly; keep templates

title: The segment's cash income is invisible to the product
evidence: Personas earn cash (en.json personas); TengoRepository has no add method (src/data/repository.ts:75 to 96); stokvels not modelled (Findex 19.6 percent)
recommendation: Add cash in, cash out and cash on hand entry, plus stokvel contributions

title: No evidence of outcomes for a bank buyer
evidence: Synthetic data only (fact sheet); bank value inputs are all Assumption (model-inputs.md section 5)
recommendation: Run 5 to 8 user sessions, publish backtest, offer a control-group pilot with four KPIs

title: A consumer subscription does not fit the segment
evidence: Capitec account R7.50 a month; free bank budgeting tools; PayFast 3.2 percent plus R2; finance app day 30 retention 4.2 to 15 percent (weak source)
recommendation: Keep Tengo free; test a paid tier only for small business owners later

title: The distribution story conflicts with the product as shown
evidence: Landing stat "Bank logins needed"; CSV-only onboarding (src/pages/Import.tsx); open banking start date unconfirmed
recommendation: Pitch one channel: inside the bank app with bank data and consent; CSV is the demo path

title: The pitch overclaims languages
evidence: Landing "Official languages" stat; all 10 non-English locales are English (fact sheet, src/i18n/status.json, walkthrough item 5)
recommendation: Show one or two reviewed languages or reword the stat
resolution: Phase 3: the landing stat and every language claim reworded honestly.

title: One buyer, one channel
evidence: Built for an FNB competition (README line 9); Capitec 15.3m, Absa 5.4m, Nedbank 3.2m digital users exist
recommendation: Prepare white-label and platform-partner tracks alongside FNB

title: Brand assets are not commercially cleared
evidence: Public Stunt personal-use licence and unconfirmed name origin (BRIEF.md sections 1 and 5); placeholder logo (fact sheet)
recommendation: Clear the font licence, confirm the name, run a trademark search

title: No written business case in the repository
evidence: README.md and BRIEF.md have no buyer, pricing or metrics section
recommendation: Add a one-page business case linked to model.xlsx

title: Zero evidence of demand or behaviour change
evidence: No users or sessions in repo; personas fictional (README.md:11, src/data/seed/personas.ts)
recommendation: Run 5 to 8 sessions with real irregular earners and quote them

title: Core insight easy to copy and partly exists
evidence: src/engine/forecast.ts is 368 lines of percentiles; FNB My available funds since 2018 (BusinessTech); Pocket Runway
recommendation: Pitch design, segment and language work as the asset; position as bank licence

title: Headline, safe to spend and chart contradict
evidence: ayanda-home-dark-390.png Short plus R310 safe plus chart Enough; forecast.ts:282-296; DateHero.tsx:9 shows Enough until for Tight
recommendation: One rule per screen; Tight until label; daily cap when Short
resolution: Phase 1: one rule per screen enforced by the Home view model and its tests.

title: No path to real data
evidence: CSV only, PDF not built (fact-sheet.md); open finance not finalised (Moonstone, Stitch)
recommendation: Name bank-embedded data route and write integration spec

title: Overclaiming 11 languages
evidence: landing-light-1280.png stat; src/i18n/status.json all pending; en.json:475 says machine made
recommendation: Honest stat now; two reviewed languages before submission
resolution: Phase 3: the claim now reads Built for 11 languages. English today.

title: Accuracy unproven, demo tuned to states
evidence: Seed balance chosen to hit Tight, Enough, Short (src/data/seed/generate.ts, fact-sheet.md)
recommendation: Backtest on real consented statements and report error and band coverage

title: Who pays is undefined
evidence: No pricing in README.md or BRIEF.md; nav Money is free (Engineering News 2022)
recommendation: Choose B2B2C bank licence and state bank value hypothesis

title: Headline date ignores income
evidence: forecast.ts:195-211; Lerato Enough until 1 Nov driven by rent though paid 24 Oct
recommendation: Test what users think the date means; lead with state when income comes first

title: Advice-like outputs raise harm exposure
evidence: safeToLend forecast.ts:357-368; help.ts:58-73 suggests moving car instalment
recommendation: Exclude credit instalments; reword safe to lend; add estimate not advice line
resolution: Phases 1 and 3: credit instalments excluded, Room to lend reworded with caution, estimate-not-advice lines.

title: Cash and informal flows invisible
evidence: Engine reads bank rows only (forecast.ts:105-191); Ayanda cash takings
recommendation: Add cash in hand and owed entries; test with cash heavy user

title: Placeholder brand and unconfirmed name
evidence: BRIEF.md section 1; fact-sheet.md placeholders
recommendation: Confirm name with Venda speaker; simple wordmark
resolution: Phase 3: name story off by default; name confirmation and logo are human actions.

title: Dependency vulnerabilities and one large bundle
evidence: audit.md: 2 critical, 5 high, react-router moderate; 696 KB single JS file
recommendation: Update react-router; split locale files

title: Make one rule drive the Home screen
evidence: ayanda-home-dark-1280.png Short plus R310 plus chart Enough; thabo-home-light-390.png and landing-dark-1280.png Enough until with Tight; UX-01, UX-02, UX-03, UX-04, PROD-03, INV-03, BEH-04, LEGAL-08, RISK-04, A11Y-03
recommendation: State-specific hero label, daily limit tied to state with usual spend, no state word on chart readout, one next-money date, recapture landing mock
resolution: Phase 1: homeView() in src/engine/view.ts drives every Home element; view.test.ts checks every persona on 60 days, balance sweeps and edge cases for consistency.

title: Replace the 11-languages claim and fix page language
evidence: landing stat 11 Official languages; locales identical to English (L10N-01); html lang wrong (A11Y-01, L10N-05); L10N-02; COMM-08; INV-05
recommendation: Honest stat, lang=en while pending, one reviewed Gauteng language if time allows
resolution: Phase 3: Built for 11 languages. English today. on Landing, picker and Me; html lang is the language of the shown text; status chips per language.

title: Remove outputs that could cause harm
evidence: help.ts:62 suggests late car instalment; Safe to lend with Use button; shared buffer double counted; LEGAL-01, LEGAL-02, RISK-09, RISK-11, BEH-01, BEH-03, BEH-05, PROD-04, INV-09
recommendation: Never move credit, insurance or rent; rename safe to lend; exclude stock and fuel from cuts; estimate-not-advice line on Home, Plan, help
resolution: Phases 1 and 3: help only offers earn or receive more, trim spending marked flexible, or move a bill marked movable; credit, insurance, rent, school fees and funeral cover are never moved; stock and fuel never trimmed; borrowing caution and not-advice lines on Home, Plan and Help.

title: Engine does not notice when the pattern breaks
evidence: RISK-01 S11 Enough after 35 days without pay; RISK-03; RISK-10; TECH-01 Ayanda Short to Enough after 30 days; DATA-05 missed payout 36.8 percent false reassurance
recommendation: Paused income rule, no-income state, payday-today rule, asOf date and data age, with unit tests
resolution: Phase 2: paused income, no-income state, payday-today rule, stale-balance handling and data age, each with unit tests; stress cases S01 to S13 are permanent tests (src/engine/stress.test.ts).

title: Put the backtest in the pitch with its limits
evidence: backtest/results/summary_headline.csv MAE 2.1 vs 3.4, coverage 71.8 percent; DATA-01 circular; DATA-02 Tight short 24.4 percent; COMM-01
recommendation: One slide or About section with synthetic caveat, stated band coverage, honest Tight copy

title: No business case or single distribution story
evidence: COMM-11, INV-07 no pricing; COMM-07 0 Bank logins vs bank embed; PROD-02, PROD-06, COMM-02, COMM-03
recommendation: One page: bank-embedded licence, fees and floor, in-app push, bank-has vs Tengo-adds, data contract, pilot KPIs

title: No user evidence
evidence: INV-01, COMM-05 no sessions; BEH-08 claim untested; BEH user-testing plan
recommendation: Run BEH tasks T1 and T2 with six real earners after fixes; report and quote

title: Cash income invisible
evidence: BEH-02 FinScope 94 percent withdraw cash; COMM-04; INV-10; BEH-07; PROD-07
recommendation: One-tap cash in hand and quick entries feeding the forecast; bank-only label until used

title: Offline fails on first visit
evidence: A11Y-02 blank page after one visit; TECH-05 registration on load and naive cache; tests/flows.spec.ts:131-140 reloads online first
recommendation: Precache build at install, offline fallback, test offline after first visit

title: First-impression issues on Plan, consent, privacy and colour
evidence: UX-06 pre-filled Plan; UX-09, LEGAL-03, SEC-06 messages on by default; SEC-01, SEC-02 ticks and retention; UX-05 light Tight vs Short
recommendation: Empty Plan, messages off, neutral planned icons and conditional copy, amber Tight
resolution: Phase 1: labelled Plan example, messages off by default, neutral icons with In this demo and Planned sections on Privacy, distinct amber Tight.

title: Name meaning and brand assets unconfirmed
evidence: L10N-12 mutengo may mean price; INV-11; COMM-10 font licence and placeholder logo
recommendation: Confirm name with two Tshivenda speakers before using the name story
resolution: Phase 3: name story off by default; confirmation and final logo listed in docs/HUMAN-ACTIONS.md.

title: No demo script built on the strongest screens
evidence: No deck or script in repo; walkthrough items 5 and 10; UX walkthrough
recommendation: Three-minute script: tagline, reconciled Short, Why drawer, loan check, pattern-break case, backtest, business page
